authority_ceiling: Soft structural governance may affect advisory context, telemetry, experimental routing preference and human explanation only. A soft observation, score, exposure flag or surface similarity cannot authorize an action, change truth or M/E status, widen a claim ceiling, establish Owner or epistemic acceptance, authorize an external side effect or release a safety gate. Current State remains CURRENT_WITH_OPEN_OBLIGATIONS and EPISTEMICALLY_ACCEPTED=0.

items.label: 模型或 Agent 共识不产生 authority

relation.antecedent: One or more models, Agents, reviewers or executors produce matching judgments or receipts.
relation.candidate_transition: The record may note agreement as bounded observation or review evidence.

blocked_transitions: Do not convert agreement into Owner authority, truth or permission.
needed_for_stronger_transition: Bind each judgment to its role, source, scope and independent validation path.
items.licensed_weaker_conclusion: The named participants agreed within the recorded task and evidence boundary.
items.unknown_behavior: Whether the agreed proposition is true or externally valid remains unresolved without its own evidence.

items.label: 工程完成不等于外部真值

relation.antecedent: A repository implementation, validator, CI run or bounded pilot reaches its declared local completion state.
relation.candidate_transition: The local record may transition to a repository-scoped engineering completion state.

blocked_transitions: Do not infer external truth, production safety or universal validity.
needed_for_stronger_transition: Use the declared repository validator and retain its scope and residuals.
items.licensed_weaker_conclusion: The bounded implementation or fixture passed the named repository checks.
items.unknown_behavior: If external evidence is absent, external truth remains unknown rather than false or true.

items.label: 证据级别不能自动越级

relation.antecedent: A source, fixture, review or observation supports a conclusion at a bounded evidence level.
relation.candidate_transition: The conclusion may be stated only up to the licensed level and scope.

blocked_transitions: Do not widen scope, quantifier, causal force or generality without a new gate.
needed_for_stronger_transition: Use the claim ceiling, provenance and relevant adjudication or replication requirement.
items.licensed_weaker_conclusion: The source supports the strongest explicitly licensed conclusion and no more.
items.unknown_behavior: The next stronger claim remains unknown or pending its named obligation.

items.label: local fixture 不等于 production 或 generalization

relation.antecedent: A disposable fixture or offline pilot produces a reproducible observation.
relation.candidate_transition: The fixture may support a repository-scoped compatibility or coordination statement.

blocked_transitions: Do not generalize the result to production, all models, all providers or the external world.
needed_for_stronger_transition: Name the fixture, environment, provider status and untested dimensions.
items.licensed_weaker_conclusion: The behavior was observed in the specified disposable local fixture.
items.unknown_behavior: Production behavior and cross-environment transfer remain unknown.

items.label: 来源或 provenance 缺失时降级

relation.antecedent: A proposed claim, observation or publication lacks recoverable source, rights or provenance binding.
relation.candidate_transition: The item may remain private, pending, non-republished or bounded as an observation.

blocked_transitions: Do not treat a summary, path, hash or confidence score as a substitute for missing source bytes.
needed_for_stronger_transition: Recover the required source and rights binding or preserve the restrictive disposition.
items.licensed_weaker_conclusion: A source-bounded note records that the material could not yet be admitted at a stronger level.
items.unknown_behavior: The unsupported proposition remains unknown and cannot enter a stronger public claim path.

items.label: M 与 E 独立

relation.antecedent: A mathematical maturity, formalization or engineering-quality observation changes on one axis.
relation.candidate_transition: Only the named axis and its evidence-bound record may change.

blocked_transitions: Do not infer an automatic M-to-E or E-to-M upgrade.
needed_for_stronger_transition: Use the independent axis gate and preserve the other axis as recorded.
items.licensed_weaker_conclusion: The specified maturity or evidence dimension has the recorded local status.
items.unknown_behavior: The unaltered axis remains at its prior or unknown status.

items.label: Owner authority 不能由 Agent 自赋

relation.antecedent: An Agent, model, receipt or local workflow proposes an Owner-level acceptance or permission decision.
relation.candidate_transition: The proposal may be recorded for Owner review without changing Owner state.

blocked_transitions: Do not self-assign Owner acceptance, Owner authority or an Owner gate result.
needed_for_stronger_transition: Require the explicit Owner-controlled gate and its auditable record.
items.licensed_weaker_conclusion: A bounded proposal or review packet is ready for the authorized Owner decision.
items.unknown_behavior: Owner acceptance remains pending when the Owner gate is absent.

items.label: 权限交集只能收窄

relation.antecedent: Task, profile, pack, executor and approval scopes are composed for a proposed action.
relation.candidate_transition: The effective capability is the validated intersection of declared scopes.

blocked_transitions: Do not widen permission because a model is cautious, a surface was read or an ESI score is high.
needed_for_stronger_transition: Use the canonical policy/permission intersection and explicit approval contract.
items.licensed_weaker_conclusion: The action is permitted only within the smallest declared intersection, or is denied.
items.unknown_behavior: An unproven capability or permission remains unavailable rather than implicitly granted.

items.label: 写作或出版完成不等于真值成立

relation.antecedent: A report, Results Book entry or public-safe explanation has passed its publication and privacy gates.
relation.candidate_transition: The material may become a bounded public projection with its claim ceiling preserved.

blocked_transitions: Do not infer that publication proves the represented proposition.
needed_for_stronger_transition: Preserve source, provenance, privacy, disposition and claim ceiling.
items.licensed_weaker_conclusion: The text is a public-safe, source-bounded representation of a recorded result or open question.
items.unknown_behavior: Unresolved truth and replication remain unknown after publication.

items.label: runtime 成功不等于 epistemic acceptance

relation.antecedent: A local runtime, executor adapter, pilot, receipt or recovery path reaches a terminal success state.
relation.candidate_transition: The local operational record may transition to its declared bounded completion status.

blocked_transitions: Do not set EPISTEMICALLY_ACCEPTED or claim external success from the runtime state.
needed_for_stronger_transition: Preserve the explicit runtime claim ceiling and separate epistemic/Owner gates.
items.licensed_weaker_conclusion: The named local run or contract completed under its bounded conditions.
items.unknown_behavior: Epistemic acceptance remains 0 and external validity remains unresolved.

items.label: 未知必须保留为未知

relation.antecedent: The evidence packet, provenance or gate does not license a stronger conclusion.
relation.candidate_transition: The record may retain UNKNOWN, conditional or pending status.

blocked_transitions: Do not fill an evidence gap with a plausible story, consensus or formatting cue.
needed_for_stronger_transition: Name the missing evidence or authority required for a future transition.
items.licensed_weaker_conclusion: The proposition is unresolved within the specified scope and evidence boundary.
items.unknown_behavior: Unknown is a valid terminal or holding state until new qualifying evidence arrives.

items.label: 撤回或隔离不得改名回弹

relation.antecedent: A claim or result is withdrawn, quarantined, downgraded or marked historical.
relation.candidate_transition: It remains in append-only lineage with the restrictive disposition.

blocked_transitions: Do not revive it by changing its title, identifier, wording or projection surface.
needed_for_stronger_transition: Require a governed successor with new provenance and independently reviewed evidence.
items.licensed_weaker_conclusion: The older record is historical or withdrawn and may explain why it is not currently usable.
items.unknown_behavior: The successor remains unknown or bounded until its own gates pass.
